purpose: Ownership ledger for the EventBus autoload (res://scripts/core/event_bus.gd). tests/python/test_regress_audit_cleanup.py reads this file and fails if the bus and the ledger drift apart in either direction, so a new channel — or a new campaign use of an existing one — has to be written down here on purpose.

policy.rule: The bus carries notifications for decoupled observers (UI, audio, visuals, analytics). It never owns state: every entry names the typed class that owns the state the signal describes. A signal whose role list contains only forbidden roles is a state channel and fails the test.
policy.subscription_rule: A node that is created and freed per run subscribes with EventBus.bind(host, signal, callable) so leaving the tree unbinds. Session-lifetime observers (UI screens built once in _ready) may use raw connect(); every such file is listed in allowed_raw_connect.

game_state_changed.note: Notification of a transition GameRoot already validated and applied; no listener can request one through the bus.

enemy_killed.note: CampaignEncounters observes it for streaming bookkeeping. Replacing that observe-with-a-typed-signal link means moving defeat ownership onto CampaignDirector, which is the campaign data-flow restructure tracked as docs/CODE_QUALITY_AUDIT_2026-09-12.md finding 14 — deliberately not attempted here.

weapon_equipped.note: CampaignDirector also observes it as a save trigger; the equip itself is a typed WeaponManager call.

objective_resolved.owner: ObjectiveDirector decides the condition, GameRoot decides victory vs game over
objective_resolved.note: Closest remaining state-trigger-shaped channel on the bus: exactly one consumer (GameRoot). Moving it to a direct typed call touches arena run lifecycle, which this cleanup is not allowed to restructure; recorded as a follow-up for the arena-mode owner.

campaign_uses.purpose: world visibility, checkpoint flush and teardown on state transitions
persistence trigger after a loadout change
streaming bookkeeping: retire the active slot and record the defeat
visual/analytics fan-out for a newly streamed guard

allowed_raw_connect.reason: Built once in CampaignGame._ready and never rebuilt per run; there is no per-run teardown for bind() to guard.
Owned by CampaignUI, which is itself session-lifetime; the armory is never re-created inside a session.

diagnostic_api.rule: Every report_* call is allowed anywhere: it is the diagnostic channel (the 'diagnostic' signal), not a state channel, and the test does not count it as a bus subscription.

moved_to_typed_ownership.state: campaign progress (mission cursor, defeated ids, interacted ids, checkpoint)
moved_to_typed_ownership.channel: CampaignEncounters.member_defeated (typed signal, connected directly by the director) instead of a bus broadcast

moved_to_typed_ownership.state: HUD/pause/result screen text and objective line
moved_to_typed_ownership.channel: direct typed signals from the director to CampaignUI/CampaignHud
